description.zh: 群组创建者ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。
description.en: The ID of the group creator. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits.

description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2593195~~)中的数据中心一致, 当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2593195~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

description.zh: 要创建的群组ID，业务应保证群组ID唯一，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。
description.en: The ID of the group that you want to create. The group ID must be unique within your business. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits.

description.zh: 群组扩展信息，长度不超过32KB。
description.en: The additional information about the group. The value can be up to 32 KB in length.

description.zh: 群组名，长度不超过128字节。
description.en: The name of the group. The name can be up to 128 bytes in length.

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)创建互动消息应用。
- 单个互动消息应用下最多可创建5000个互动消息群组。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
*   Before you call this operation, make sure that you have called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation to create an interactive messaging application.
*   You can create up to 5,000 interactive messaging groups in an interactive messaging application.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --group-name mytestgroup --group-info testgroupinfo --administrators uid1 --creator-id uid1 --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live CreateLiveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName mytestgroup --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --GroupInfo testgroupinfo --CreatorId uid1 --Administrators uid1 --GroupId grouptest
